item.title: Improved mobile coverage could unlock 49,000 new UK businesses, VodafoneThree says
item.description: VodafoneThree research suggests better mobile connectivity could create 49,000 new UK businesses and add £6.6bn annually to the economy within a decade. Read more: Improved mobile coverage could unlock 49,000 new UK businesses, VodafoneThree says

item.title: Youth jobless crisis deepens as AI and higher taxes hit hiring
item.description: UK job vacancies have fallen to their lowest level since 2021, with graduate roles dropping sharply as national insurance rises and AI adoption curb recruitment. Read more: Youth jobless crisis deepens as AI and higher taxes hit hiring

item.title: Custom acrylic manufacturer Midton targets 20% annual growth after £429,000 tech investment at Argyll foundry
item.description: Argyll-based Midton is expanding its acrylic awards manufacturing capacity following a £429,000 investment in new biomass-powered technology. Read more: Custom acrylic manufacturer Midton targets 20% annual growth after £429,000 tech investment at Argyll foundry

item.title: SEND overhaul unlikely to curb rising costs before 2030, government concedes
item.description: The government says special needs spending will continue rising until 2030 despite SEND reforms, with EHCP numbers expected to grow before stabilising. Read more: SEND overhaul unlikely to curb rising costs before 2030, government concedes

item.title: Trump’s new 15% tariff plan ‘will hit UK exporters and dent global growth’
item.description: The British Chambers of Commerce warns President Trump’s new 15% global tariff could harm 40,000 UK exporters and weaken global economic growth. Read more: Trump’s new 15% tariff plan ‘will hit UK exporters and dent global growth’

item.title: £4bn SEND funding welcomed as experts warn of backlog pressures
item.description: The government has announced a £4bn SEND investment, including £1.6bn for mainstream schools, but experts warn funds may be absorbed by rising demand. Read more: £4bn SEND funding welcomed as experts warn of backlog pressures

item.title: Ex-Amazon boss Doug Gurr set to become permanent CMA chair
item.description: Former Amazon UK chief Doug Gurr has been named as the government’s preferred candidate to lead the Competition and Markets Authority for a full five-year term. Read more: Ex-Amazon boss Doug Gurr set to become permanent CMA chair

item.title: Lamborghini scraps electric supercar plans and doubles down on hybrids
item.description: Lamborghini has cancelled its planned Lanzador EV, with CEO Stephan Winkelmann saying weak demand makes full-electric models financially risky. Read more: Lamborghini scraps electric supercar plans and doubles down on hybrids

item.title: Brompton shifts focus to China as US tariff turmoil dents confidence
item.description: Brompton Bicycle has closed US stores and slowed American investment, citing tariff uncertainty, while expanding its retail footprint in China. Read more: Brompton shifts focus to China as US tariff turmoil dents confidence

item.title: What Are the Top ISO Certification Providers?
item.description: As business leaders assess the most effective ways to remain competitive and in demand within a challenging marketplace, many set goals to secure certifications from the International Organization for Standardization. The ISO does not award these, but relies on external partners. Read more: What Are the Top ISO Certification Providers?
